column3: NKJV has “though He bears long with them,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “and will He delay over them?”
Close to the Greek; “swindlers” is rendered “extortioners.”
NKJV has “in heaven,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “in the heavens.”
NKJV has “that he became very sorrowful,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has only “having seen him.”
NKJV has “left all,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “left our own things.”
NKJV lists “parents or brothers or wife,” the order of the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “wife or brothers or parents.”
